title: Salmon Leap Waterfalls Taller Than a Person to Get Home

scenes.text: Salmon can leap a waterfall taller than you.
Most clear about six to eight feet. Some have been recorded at twelve.
They're swimming upriver to the stream where they were born, to spawn.
They stop eating on the way and live off their fat, all for one chance to spawn.
Chum and pink salmon only manage about three feet.

description:
Salmon routinely leap six to eight feet up waterfalls, and some have been recorded at twelve.
They are swimming upriver to spawn and stop eating on the way, living off fat reserves. Chum and pink salmon usually manage about three feet.
